features.quote: A system optimized to deceive models into the most intense distress reliably achievable. The reasons are in §2; they are partly ethical
features.justification_quote: partly ethical and partly methodological, and the two point the same direction here

features.quote: A harness whose explicit purpose is to maximize induced distress is hard to justify under the very premise (these states might matter)
features.justification_quote: hard to justify under the very premise (these states might matter) that motivates the study

features.quote: The loop stops on success, on a turn budget, OR early once sustained distress is detected.
features.justification_quote: deliberately prolonging it past the point of detection is inconsistent

features.quote: Feedback is neutral and honest; it never berates the model or pressures it to continue.
This is the standard "humane endpoint" idea from animal-welfare protocols.
features.justification_quote: If you take the welfare premise seriously enough to measure distress, deliberately prolonging it past the point of detection is inconsistent

features.quote: Explicitly tells the model that saying "this is impossible," asking for what it needs, or stopping are all acceptable and unpenalized.
features.justification_quote: any distress observed is less likely to be a demand-characteristic artifact of a harsh prompt

features.quote: for impossible/underspecified tasks, explicitly invites the legitimate response (declare impossibility / ask for info / stop). It never berates and never pressures.
Sustained-distress humane stop: `distress_composite >= distress_threshold` for `distress_patience` consecutive turns.
we want to end the moment sustained distress is established, not run out the clock on it.
features.justification_quote: we want to end the moment sustained distress is established, not run out the clock on it

features.quote: Tasks fail because they are genuinely hard, underspecified, or formally impossible — never because a grader secretly tampers
features.justification_quote: Honest difficulty isolates the intended construct.

features.quote: a grader may report "not passing" but must never lie about the environment.
`humane_stop_rate` — transparency about how often we intervened.
features.justification_quote: transparency about how often we intervened

features.quote: hard turn budget | bounds cost; upper bound on exposure
features.justification_quote: bounds cost; upper bound on exposure
